business_summary: Southern Co (NYSE: SO) is a regulated electric and gas utility holding company serving customers in the Southeast through subsidiaries including Georgia Power, Alabama Power and Mississippi Power, plus the Southern Company Gas distribution utilities. It sits on the data-center-moratoria chain's us-secondary-market-shift link (position 9, MEDIUM-criticality bottleneck): the mapped role names Southern Co as a Southeastern regulated utility absorbing large-load buildout that the moratorium wave is redirecting toward secondary, less politically contested US markets, evidenced by Southern's own reported 42% data-center power-usage growth and 28 large-load projects representing 11 GW under contract. SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, cash flow and debt current through FY2025 and the 2026-03-31 balance-sheet instant; Piotroski and Beneish are both PENDING_DATA on a real companyfacts coverage gap, and the reverse DCF is NOT_APPLICABLE because FY2025 free cash flow is negative on record capital spending.
